notes.title: Update notes for September 16
notes.content:
We have received lots of feedbacks from You, and we are extremely grateful for that. In this patch, the focus is on smaller bug fixes and improvements:


 Added a new tutorial window to highlight the spawner gate openings
 New hotkeys to upgrade (U) and sell (X) the selected tower
 Scythe Tower Nerf
 Design fixes of Undead Barrack's spawned archers

notes.title: Update Notes for Sept 8
notes.content:
New Update
Thank you for your feedbacks, a quick update with the most crucial ones are here:

 Added a 2x speed button to make the game faster and more enjoyable
 Now you can separetely set the volume of the music and the sound effects
 Small balance for late game
